meta: Bakeries use AI to work out costs: many sell lots and still lose money at the end of the month because they never calculated the real cost of each item.

muc.title: Busy, but still losing money
muc.text: Many bakeries sell a lot and still lose money at month's end, because they never fully costed each item.

muc.title: Cost per item
muc.text: Type one batch's recipe and ingredient prices into a chatbot and ask for the cost of each item.

muc.title: A few profit levels
muc.text: Ask AI for a price table at a few profit margins, then pick the one that suits your local customers.

muc.title: Turn orders into a table
muc.text: Paste order messages, with phone numbers removed, and ask AI to put them in a table by delivery date.

muc.title: Cost of your best seller
muc.text: Ask a chatbot to calculate the cost of your best-selling cake, then check the math with a calculator.

thu: Ask a chatbot to calculate the cost of your best-selling cake, then check the math with a calculator.
